value.rationale: The invariant is natural: the full support of the twofold convolution, or equivalently the inverse Fourier transform of the squared indicator spectrum, for a conic with its canonical tangent. The theorem proves a complete pointwise characterization, a sharp finite-field covering threshold (q=3,5 only), and a universal 3/4 support-density limit from elliptic curve point-counting. This distinguishes a genuine curved-plus-flat Fourier support from torus-only sums and supplies exact test cases for finite-field restriction/synthesis analyses. It is not simply a code check or an arbitrary parameter slice.
